notes: Identity verified from supplied full article text: title Music-Evoked Nostalgia: Affect, Memory, and Personality; authors Frederick S. Barrett, Kevin J. Grimm, Richard W. Robins, Tim Wildschut, Constantine Sedikides, and Petr Janata; Emotion (2010), 10(3), 390–403; DOI 10.1037/a0019006. This is a primary empirical report with Method, Results, Tables 1–2, discussion and references. No PDF was supplied; no rendering performed. Table 1 labels estimates standardized. Data Analysis (pp. 393–394) says context-level variables were standardized within participants except nostalgia and the mixed-emotion dummy; person-level scores standardized across participants. Retain printed β without converting to a fully standardized outcome coefficient. Mixed-emotion β is for the unstandardized dummy predictor. Unassigned replication and success fields are placeholders only. Unassigned fields must not overwrite verified values. Method reports 226 participants and Results reports 6,720 song presentations during the experiment. These are overall counts; the context/person mixed models do not explicitly state target-model analytic participant or presentation counts or exclusions. Neither count is promoted to analytic N; no N inferred from df or multiplication.
